description: Decode an ISO 20275 Entity Legal Form (ELF) code to its registered name, language, country and jurisdiction. This is the 4-character code GLEIF publishes as `legal_form` on every LEI record (get_lei, search_lei results) — "XJHM" decodes to Sweden's "Aktiebolag", for example. Two sentinel codes carry no country or jurisdiction: "8888" (no specific legal form recorded — used where the concept does not apply, e.g. some government entities) and "9999" (legal form not yet classified by the registering LOU); both are flagged via `is_sentinel` rather than answered as a plain lookup miss. get_lei already decodes this field inline as legal_form_decoded — call this tool directly only when you have a bare code from elsewhere.

code.description: 4-character ISO 20275 ELF code, e.g. "XJHM" (Sweden, Aktiebolag) or the sentinel "8888"/"9999". Read it off an LEI record's legal_form field — do not guess one.

name: decode_elf_code
title: Decode Elf Code
